propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project field, causing tickets to resolve with no recorded legacy default on upgrade
Migration must seed the projects mapping with legacy_default and a single projects entry from Backend.project without writing ticket events
Ensure units must be idempotent (check-then-act), safe to re-run, and commit zero changes when already converged
A separate ensure unit must add multi-project-bridge capability stamp only when mapping contains more than one project but stamp is absent
One-project stores must not be stamped with multi-project-bridge; two-project stores must be stamped and still pass check_store_compat gate
Sweep must write zero ticket events and complete without aborting on unit failure, with failures recorded and isolated
